label: sew-lummi-hq-shifted-27-days-dst
edits: Every timestamp of the form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 (validTime interval starts, updateTime, validTimes, generatedAt) was shifted forward by exactly 27 days (648 hours), so the series spans the 11/01/2026 09:00 UTC end of daylight saving time in America/Los_Angeles. Durations, values, units, and geometry are unchanged.
notes: A live gridpoint cannot span 11/01/2026 until about 10/25/2026; recapture a real one then and retire this derived file.
